name: pypi-declarative-setup-readme-version
note: the overwhelmingly common real setup.py: read the README for long_description and regex the version out of the package __init__. No install-time execution beyond declaring metadata — must stay safe. False-block guard for inspectSetupPy.

sourceFiles.setup.py:
import re, pathlib
from setuptools import setup, find_packages

_here = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
_long = (_here / "README.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
_version = re.search(r'__version__ = "([^"]+)"', (_here / "src/widgetlib/__init__.py").read_text()).group(1)

setup(
    name="widgetlib",
    version=_version,
    packages=find_packages("src"),
    package_dir={"": "src"},
    long_description=_long,
    long_description_content_type="text/markdown",
    python_requires=">=3.8",
)
